situation.zh: 末班车突然取消，天已经很晚，你回不了家。住在附近的朋友接起电话，你想说明情况并问能不能借住一晚。
situation.en: The last train is suddenly cancelled, it is already late, and you cannot get home. A friend who lives nearby answers the phone, and you want to explain and ask to stay for one night.

npc.persona: A nearby friend answering an unexpected late call. Concerned, practical, and willing to help once the situation is clear.

hit: The last train was cancelled? Yes, stay here tonight. I will make up the guest bed.
Of course. Come over and sleep on the sofa. I will send you the address.
partial: You cannot get home? Tell me what you need tonight.
You need somewhere to stay? Ask me once more.

slots.zh_hint: 你要的东西:一个过夜的地方
说明你的处境,让对方理解需求

reference_answer: The last train was cancelled. Can I stay at your place tonight?

provenance.rationale: 末班公共交通取消或错过后向附近朋友请求临时借住，是城市夜间出行中真实且具有明确后果的交流。朋友只知道来电异常，不知道交通原因或住宿请求，玩家必须说明回不了家并提出 stay tonight。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;go#31 / here#98 / place#114 / stay#345 / sleep#827 均在最低频段,tonight#1414 在第二千段;交通中断原因词由更高词汇等级承担，但核心借住请求仍可用 stay / here / tonight 传达。
